settings.err_intro: Recent driver steps and errors (pairing, init, cluster binds). Newest first. Survives an app restart.
settings.verbose_hint: Adds init steps, reporting setup and commands sent. Too noisy for everyday use, but turn it on when bringing up a new device. Takes effect immediately.
settings.zdump_intro: Endpoints and clusters of every device paired to this app. Load it, then copy the JSON to share a device's Zigbee interview.
settings.log_intro: Raw values, to analyse a mid-clean recharge. Run a full clean, then export and share the CSV.

pair.no_reply: No reply from the robot. Check the IP, and wake it in the Xiaomi app.

devialet.source_unavailable: That source is not currently available (speaker off, or the group was reconfigured).
